scope: Exact source inline native ESLint exceptions, separate from React Doctor diagnostics and existing native design-system debt counts.

exceptions.reason: The render-time factory only captures the supplied refs and returns an async payment event handler. Every ref read/write is inside that returned handler; factory creation itself performs no ref access. The compiler lint heuristically treats passing a ref to any function as a possible read.
evidence: Root ESLint file-level react-hooks/refs error configuration keeps the same compiler check active under the shared lint context; one factory-only disable remains. Root lint --fix and app lint both preserve it.
exceptions.reconsiderWhen: Reconsider if the factory body reads/writes a ref before invocation or submission ownership, mount identity, revision or idempotency contracts change.
